milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because crafting acacia_planks from acacia_logs results in planks appearing in the player's inventory. The player starts with 3 acacia_logs and 0 acacia_planks, so any acacia_planks in inventory confirms the craft was performed. Recipe: 1 acacia_log → 4 acacia_planks (works in 2x2 inventory grid or 3x3 crafting table). No false positives possible since no acacia_planks exist in the scene.

Uses inventory_has because crafting acacia_stairs from acacia_planks results in stairs appearing in the player's inventory. The player starts with 0 acacia_stairs and no acacia_stairs blocks exist in the scene, so any acacia_stairs in inventory confirms the craft was performed. Recipe: 6 acacia_planks → 4 acacia_stairs (requires 3x3 crafting table grid). The crafting table is placed at ~2 ~0 ~2, confirmed accessible in sandbox.
